classification: preregistered negative-earnings-forecast tail-filter experiment; no scoring, weight, holding-period or risk-budget tuning

data.filter_rule: retain only rows with forecast_surprise_60d >= 0; no-event zero rows pass; negative announcements are excluded from new entries

gates.D1_data: factor coverage >=95%, all four strategy runs produce finite outputs, filter removes between 1% and 10% of score universe rows
gates.G5_year_increment: 2022 and 2023 returns each improve by at least 1pp versus control
gates.G6_recent: recent five-start mean >0 and at least 4/5 positive

known_limitations: R63 already found high positive forecast surprise did not produce a stable long-only strategy; this round tests negative-tail exclusion, not positive surprise alpha.
The filter is sparse (about 4% negative rows) and may not materially change annual returns.
All variants share the same history and R40 local snapshot.
Canonical data drift, current industry snapshot and factor version drift remain unresolved.
A passing filtered variant cannot be deployed without a separate concentration and paper-execution review.
portfolio_rule: unchanged R312: A/B 60d inverse-vol risk parity (A bounds [0.2,0.8]), then 15% total volatility target [0.2,1.0], monthly, no leverage
question: R315-R319 已证明旧 A/B 内部调参无法改善年度稳定性。用 R63 已构建的 PIT 业绩预告 surprise 做纯尾部过滤，剔除近 60 日负向预告股票，能否减少 2022/2023 负年并改善随机一年尾部，而不破坏完整收益和压力成本？
selection_rule: Judge all variants by G1-G8. Among passers, choose highest bootstrap positive rate, tie-break by bootstrap median. If none pass, keep the original R312 candidate and record negative knowledge. If a filtered variant passes, it is only a candidate for a separate concentration audit.
